title: Owner checks the corrected path against a real flight and a live GPS device
goal: Run the B-018 check with an own flight and a live GPS device and reply pass or the failing step
acceptance: The owner replies pass, or names the failing step and what was seen, with no coordinates
privacy: The owner's reply is recorded without coordinates, addresses or private flight data
validation: The owner's dated reply in the record
escalation: A failure reopens the record with a failing case before any fix

effort.basis: Needs a private flight and a live device set up; about an hour. Estimated 2026-11-26 from the record's scope at the harness 10.21.3 reconcile; no calibration samples exist yet (first hour estimates here). Estimate, not a measurement.
